dialogues.speaker: Zadith
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm worrying about which Darshan I should choose in the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Zadith
dialogues.text: My results were far better than I ever expected, so I met the requirements of all Darshans. But that brings me to another problem, there are six of them...

dialogues.speaker: Zadith
dialogues.text: I heard becoming a doctor after graduating from Amurta pays very well, but then others say that it's easier to get employment after studying architecture in Kshahrewar...
